summary: Practise PySpark, Spark SQL and data validation with guided exercises. Explore the course and build your Apache Spark foundation.
lede: Big data analytics with Apache Spark uses distributed processing to load, transform, validate and summarize datasets with PySpark and Spark SQL. Designed for aspiring data analysts, data engineers and Python developers, this foundation-level course focuses on building repeatable workflows for analytical data. You’ll practise reading CSV, JSON and Parquet files, checking data quality, creating DataFrame transformations and SQL aggregations, and validating batch pipelines, with guided introductions to Spark UI and streaming concepts.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course is designed for people who work with data pipelines, analytical datasets or Python-based data processing and want to use Apache Spark for distributed analysis. PySpark coding forms part of the practice, so basic Python familiarity will help you follow the exercises.
prerequisites: Basic Python familiarity is recommended. The exercises require writing and reviewing PySpark code; prior Apache Spark experience is not required.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
